change: No changes. Muscle encoding confirmed correct: Quads/glutes/calves primary, hamstrings/abductor/obliques secondary are all well-supported by agility drill biomechanics. Category, equipment, trackingMode verified correct.

No changes. Calves and quads as co-primary confirmed for rapid foot-tap drill (calves drive ground contact; quads provide knee stability). Glutes/hamstrings/abs secondary verified. Category, equipment, trackingMode correct.
No changes. Neck as primary and Upper Traps as secondary confirmed by multiple sources (StrengthLog, KingOfTheGym, WorkoutLabs). Category, equipment, trackingMode correct.
Added mid back->Upper Traps as secondary. Sources (ExRx, InspireUS, StrengthLog) confirm upper trapezius acts as a stabilizer during lying neck flexion/curls. Previously secondary was empty.

Removed Wrist Flexors from forearms secondary. Hammer curl uses a neutral grip (palm-in); wrist flexors are not meaningfully loaded. Brachioradialis (elbow flexor) is the key forearm mover — best approximated by Wrist Extensors in the allowed system. EMG study (PMC6047503) confirms neutral grip elevates brachioradialis/brachialis over biceps brachii, but brachialis has no allowed bucket, so biceps remains primary. Note: the system cannot fully represent brachialis as the true primary in this exercise.
